A '''mining colony''' was a mining colony located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was targeted by the [[Eradicator (weapon)|Eradicators]] during the [[Eradication Day]].
